notes.title: Our First Earthshattering Update
notes.content: Thanks to the incredible development budget of SAF!, we have been able to add major new features - namely a back button on the planet selection screen, and a quit button on the title page. We also make it explicit that ESC opens the pause menu, which is where the sound controls can be found. Thousands of development staff laboured for hours in a parallel universe to bring these awesome new features to you the players!
